description: Type createProjectsServiceAccounts' retryable IAM quota. Discovery convert only attaches default 4xx (NotFound/Forbidden/BadRequest/Conflict); HTTP 429 is not in STANDARD_4XX_TAG_TO_STATUS, so the live quota ('Service accounts created per minute per project') landed as UnknownGCPError. A dedicated tag lets Alchemy catch and retry without matching message text.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: IAM rate quota for creating service accounts in a project is exhausted (quota metric 'Service accounts created per minute per project', typically HTTP 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED). Transient — retry.

message.includes: Service accounts created per minute per project
